title: Prove the exact 3r+1 sharp-guard translation cover (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact **3r+1** coordinate-translation menu minimum for the conservative sharp compact-switch guard product, when B>=3r+1 and 2^m>=(3r+1)(B-2). The lower bound permits arbitrary translation constants in every coordinate. An explicit attaining menu shifts control digits by k and windows by k(B-2), each modulo its own period.

Claim type: **scoped proof with finite corroboration**. The source-correct logical interface is

```text
select a good phase k using restored guard coordinates
translate by D_k
apply the raw macro with source f_k = f composed with D_k inverse
undo D_k
uncompute the unchanged selector
```

This yields the ideal switch at every logical address under the cited raw endpoint contract. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. The guard-product lower bound does not cover larger actual agreement sets or coordinate-mixing maps.

The new result was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Cinna Davis/PR4100, unpaidmoon/PR4321, John-Michael Smith/PR763, Hiroki KUMAZAKI/PR4169, Ryanson Jonathan/PR4329, Douglas Colkitt and the retained ordinary/CRT lineage. The elementary coordinate adversary and pigeonhole methods are standard; the contribution is the sharp guard specialization and transported-source interface.

Advance [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19279698). Base a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7, priority revision 8. The original uniform-transfer card is retained with an explicit scope change to this new alternative guard interface. All five selected framework assumptions remain.

## Evidence

Before: the cited compact endpoint contract guarantees agreement on the sharp product good set. After: the new optimal menu sends every guard tuple into that set; the conjugated source preserves the intended switch.

- Written universal lower/upper proof and source-correct conjugation in PROOF.md.
- Five exact forbidden-phase product histograms, each with zero uncovered tuples, and separate direct one-target enumeration. Large products use compressed enumeration, not individual execution of every address.
- 8,192 endpoint cases cover all 2,048 dirty addresses in a one-target rectangle for four source families. Four larger geometries add 4,096 deterministic sampled endpoint cases. Full endpoints, inverse translations and selector invariance pass.
- 1,056 explicit arbitrary-phase menu adversary checks and seven rejecting controls pass. Missing source transport has a concrete failure at (u,t,y)=(0,0,12).
- A generated receipt binds all six source/manifest/proof files by SHA256. No predecessor checker or historical receipt was replayed.
- Warning-strict normal and isolated optimized registered checks pass on CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. Timed checks were 0.56 s and 0.57 s; each manifest timeout is 60 s.
- Exact committed bytes, executable modes and full source-history ancestry pass at c5406de0d327cfad1a4a52fe19a9b72169f7e4ae. Staged whitespace passes.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/translated-sharp-guard-cover/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/translated-sharp-guard-cover/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/translated-sharp-guard-cover
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/translated-sharp-guard-cover --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Other machines may substitute their CPython 3.12 interpreter. Expected markers are PASS_TRANSLATED_SHARP_GUARD_COVER, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE and PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES.

## Limitations

Independent modular translations, clean owned selector preparation/routing/erasure, sector-controlled raw macros, transported-source delivery, full-field shuttles and the complete physical bill remain unpriced. Unknown costs are not zero. The logical result does not replace the existing paid sparse-repair construction. No Lean, Docker, selected cold replay, complete physical implementation or multiplication theorem is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Price a legal one-target four-phase translation/selector implementation against the complete sparse-repair bill, retaining every delivery, ownership and cleanup cost.
2. Characterize a larger source-dependent agreement set for one fixed raw word, then determine whether fewer translations suffice for that different predicate.

## Related open work

No translated sharp-guard cover PR appeared in the 348-open-PR snapshot.

- #4187 studies the same PR4100 switch layer's elementary last-K branch and physical two-slice tariff. This result supplies neither that branch nor its tape-cost proof.
- #4192 studies the PR4100 Beneš compiler and charged sequential query service. Its controller generation remains a separate implementation dependency for the transported-source route.
